gold: Glioblastoma (World Health Organization grade IV) with optic nerve invasion and intraocular extension

selector.rationale: The presence of mutant IDH-1 protein and loss of ATRX protein, along with astrocytic neoplasm features, best supports IDH-mutant Astrocytoma without contradiction.

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: While present, it's a secondary complication rather than the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Astrocytic Neoplasm
rejected.why: Less specific than IDH-mutant Astrocytoma given the presence of mutant IDH-1 protein.

rejected.label: Glioblastoma
rejected.why: No clear evidence of the aggressive features typical of glioblastoma, such as high Ki-67 index or specific genetic markers beyond those for IDH-mutant Astrocytoma.

rejected.label: Glioma
rejected.why: While glioma is a broad category that includes IDH-mutant Astrocytoma, the specific molecular features point more precisely to IDH-mutant Astrocytoma.
